instruction: Using only GitHub’s visible interface, open the global search control and search for `repo:pallets/flask is:issue is:open sort:updated-desc`. Submit the search, then switch the search category from Code to Issues using the visible results-page control. Once the issue-results page is visible, do not leave it or open a result. Report the displayed open-issue result count and the exact titles of the first two visible issue results (or all visible results if fewer than two). You must perform the search entry, submission, and category switch through the UI.
